Terrible service, empty lobster shells
May 2026 • Solo
I really wanted some good seafood so I did my research to find a good place here on TripAdvisor. Given the high reviews of this place, I took a chance and gave an otherwise empty restaurant a shot. I thought maybe it was a Monday night and about 8:30pm and with so much competition in the area, it wasn’t a huge red flag. I was wrong. The waitress spent most of her time on her phone and on her laptop hardly looking at me. When the food came out, it came out in two parts. I got my two side dishes, and they sat at the table and got cold before the lobster finally showed up about 10 minutes later. It looked nice and the sauces were actually quite good garlic butter and black pepper sauce was it? She split the lobster in half and offered two sauces on separate plates. The problem was the shells were nearly completely empty. I literally got two bites of lobster. They agreed to prepare another one and it had a few more bites, but overall it was very unsatisfying. These were previously live lobsters that were then frozen a few days before. They were discounted which might have been my first red flag re: quality. Either way, when they charge by weight, I feel it is such hit or miss guessing game. Given the modest discount and the fact they cooked a second one, I paid and left but seriously considered walking out in protest.
Read more
Written May 5, 2026
Làng Cua Đà Nẵng
Dear Customer,
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are truly sorry that your visit did not meet your expectations.
Regarding the lobster portion, we would like to clarify that Vietnamese spiny lobster naturally has a lighter meat yield compared to other lobster species. Since we serve lobster by live weight, the shell, head, and natural water content are included in the total weight. Depending on the season and the individual lobster, the amount of meat can vary, even when the weight is the same.
When you mentioned your concern during the meal, our team immediately prepared a completely new lobster for you at no additional charge because we genuinely wanted you to leave satisfied. We never intentionally serve low-quality seafood or “empty shells.”
We also sincerely apologize if the service felt inattentive during your visit. This is not the standard we aim to provide, and we will speak with our staff to improve the guest experience.
Your feedback is valuable to us, and we appreciate you giving our restaurant a try. We hope you may consider visiting us again in the future so we can provide you with a much better experience.
